method: Authenticated PDF to pdftotext -layout; relevant statement/proof inspection plus whole-body term/result-heading scans. No rendered-page visual inspection claimed in this review.
negative_result_limit: A term scan can miss equivalent wording. Scope is bounded; no firstness certificate follows.

bodies.substantive_inspection_scope: Printed p.445 exact statement, influence denominator, old exponential scale and necessary obstruction. Other unrelated workshop contributions not substantively reviewed.

Definitions 2/4, Fact 3, Corollary 2, Theorems 4/8/9/10, Section 5.1 no-common-zero hypothesis and all influence/partial-function result hits. No claim of validating every theorem.
Section 3.3 arbitrary-real covariance Eq.(6) and adjacent argument, metrics/resampling setup and result/range statements. Not a full proof audit of all generalizations.

Abstract, Conjectures 1.2/5.5, Theorem 4.4, Section 5.2, Theorem 5.6 scope, and relevant result/compatibility/influence hits. Not a full audit of quantum-state equivalence.

Abstract/introduction and polynomial structural overview; all compatibility/influence hits and theorem/lemma headings screened. No inverse-polynomial compatibility theorem located; cryptographic bypass not treated as equivalence.

Abstract, introduction compatibility hits, and all result headings screened. No influence, OSSS, separator or rational-degree hits. No claim of auditing cryptographic proof.
